decls.name: FieldConstructionNumericBounds

paper_span.quote: Combining this quadratic lower bound for \(t\) with \(\log H_\ell=O(\ell\log\ell)\)

decls.rationale: Property (P6): the quadratic \(t \ge (\ell-1)^2/200\) beats \(\log H_\ell = O(\ell\log\ell)\), so \(t\log 2 - \log H_\ell > 0\) for all sufficiently large \(\ell\).
